scope: Offline received-wire collector and native encoders only; no client/app/domain integration, engine, SQL, native connection or inference

api.pump: consume_snapshot(*client.native_frame_snapshot()) -> bool; base_seq denotes last seq before retained frames
api.raw: ingest(seq, at, pid, raw); direct ingestion is caller-ordered, snapshot API provides gap/replay protection
api.view: frozen NativeGameplayView; observed positions carry seq and receipt time; actor wireID distinct from characterID
api.effects: Collector never sends; parent may call client._send(encoded) under its own policy

attackability_proof.guard: objecttype5 AND aid != ownAID AND aid != uint32(-ownAID). Ordinary clif_bl_type emits5 for ordinary non-PC-sprite BL_MOB; NPC emits6/12, pet7, unsupported omitted from combat; type5 disguised-PC override is SELF-only with exact own alias
attackability_proof.limits: Eligibility is source-derived kind discriminator only; not alive/range/permission proof. Type0 ambiguous, not blindly player. No job/name/ID-threshold/private-data heuristics.

inventory_knowledge.barrier: Pinned LoadEndAck emits inventorylist then pc_checkitem then WEIGHT status24 (clif.cpp10782-10794). Only observed auth02EB opens initial-list window. Missing barrier leaves unknown. consume_snapshot corrupt/gapped sequence poisons and clears state until new epoch; no empty-by-absence.
inventory_knowledge.limits: Bounded initialization ordering contract, not universal refresh transaction. Later list refresh completion and item consumption/deletion updates are not fully implemented. 00AF/07FA invalidate inventory knowledge rather than pretending stale counts remain complete. observed_inventory_counts are historical/partial; acquired_counts are receipt totals, not current inventory.

Normal respawn can use0091 mapmove rather than0148; mapmove does NOT itself prove revival in this implementation. Respawn send is not respawn success.
